headline: Fraxtal L1 bridge and control contracts identified on Ethereum; core addresses discoverable from GitHub and L2BEAT; additional admin/governance addresses require further exploration

rationale.verdict: Fraxtal is an OP Stack L2 with Ethereum L1 bridge infrastructure. Core L1 bridge contracts (L1StandardBridge, L1ERC721Bridge, L1CrossDomainMessenger) are identifiable from L2BEAT and Etherscan-tagged references, plus GitHub scripts; however, ownership/admin addresses and governance structures are not yet fetched from on-chain sources. Without commit SHA pinning or complete deployed-contracts doc, comprehensive address enumeration requires next-run follow-up via DeFiPunkd API reads on the pinned addresses.

protocol_metadata.about: Fraxtal is an EVM-equivalent Layer 2 chain built on the OP Stack and deployed on Ethereum. It uses frxETH, a liquid staking derivative token, as its native gas token. Fraxtal enables low-cost DeFi transactions and settlement of Frax stablecoins while maintaining EVM equivalence for easy developer onboarding.
